The '''Fist of Justice''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group that operated during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At some point, government officials assembled a team to track them.<ref name="Fist of Justice">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Fist of Justice}}</ref>
